profile.headline: Web Developer | CMO of TMR Cosmetics
profile.geoLocationName: Baltimore City County, Maryland, United States
profile.summary: Multilingual Web Developer with years of hands-on experience in crafting dynamic web solutions using JavaScript, React.js, and renowned CMS platforms like WordPress and Joomla. With an innate ability to transform intricate client needs into efficient web outcomes, I pride myself on my problem-solving prowess. Fluent in English, Korean, and Chinese, I seamlessly fit into diverse teams and excel in global project environments. Continually updating myself with emerging technologies, I'm driven by a passion for web innovation.

positions.title: Chief Marketing Officer
positions.description:
Official Website: skincaretmr.com
With 25 years in the cosmetic arena, TMR COSMETICS is dedicated to advanced skincare solutions. Amidst a bustling industry, we stand distinguished with our science-driven, effective product line—focused on anti-aging, elasticity, and holistic skin regeneration. Recognized and celebrated in South Korea's rigorous skincare realm, we represent pure beauty crafted with precision. Dive into a timeless beauty revolution with us.

positions.title: E-commerce Specialist / Web Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and launched a comprehensive e-commerce website, resulting in a 35% increase in online sales within the first quarter.
• Spearheaded the integration of products on Amazon, leading to an additional 28% growth in revenue from the platform within 6 months.
• Managed and curated content for the company's Instagram account, growing the follower base by over 750% and boosting engagement rates by 340%.
• Oversaw all e-commerce and digital marketing initiatives, leading to a 32% rise in overall digital revenue for the year.
• Implemented advanced web analytics and SEO strategies, increasing site traffic by 50% and improving rankings for several key product search terms.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Promptly addressed client support tickets, consistently replying within 10 minutes, maintaining a 100% response rate, and ensuring swift issue resolution.
• Managed and executed updates for client websites based on their specific requirements, ensuring content relevancy and improved user experiences.
• Collaborated closely with senior developers in the development of custom WordPress themes and plugins, utilizing PHP and JavaScript to deliver tailored solutions for diverse clientele.
• Played a key role in refactoring front-end code to enhance website responsiveness, readability, and maintainability, leading to a 25% improvement in page load speeds.
• Conducted thorough QA testing across multiple browsers and device sizes to ensure consistent and flawless user experiences, identifying and rectifying compatibility issues in 90% of test cases.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · WordPress · Joomla! · Amazon Web Services (AWS)
